upgrade.name: Ancient Invention blueprints (Howl's workshop)
upgrade.detail: Stormguard Citadel is Armadylean dig-site geography under Kandarin (wiki Equilibrium League tags all Stormguard hotspots Kandarin; Temple of Ikov entrance). Howl's Floating Workshop drafting bench + torn blueprint fragments are the self-sufficient no-trade path. Lowse at Armadyl's Tower (Asgarnia) is the Armadylean collector for related collections (Inspire Genius) — collector turn-in is separate from dig ownership. Do not invent fragment counts beyond wiki fragment costs (200 for targeted untradeable blueprint; 150 random). · Kandarin hard-gates Stormguard / Howl self-sufficient blueprint unlock. GE tradeable blueprints are not a League no-trade path. Invention Guild manufacture of shells/tools after unlock still pressures Asgarnia workbenches (support, not dig ownership). · Unlocks: Permanent discovery of ancient weapon / armour / tool gizmos (9-slot shells), Enhanced hammer-tron / pyro-matic / fishing rod-o-matic (level-80-class ancient tools), XP Capacitor 5000 blueprint, Theoretical blueprints path for Experimental Aether Reactor and Subtle Blade after Back to the Drawing Board research, Ancient component discovery (Classic/Historic 85, Vintage 94, Timeworn 103 Invention) for restored-artefact disassembly
requirements: 95 Archaeology for Howl's Floating Workshop / drafting bench path (self-sufficient)
Torn blueprint fragments (Howl's workshop) from Stormguard Citadel excavation (Kandarin)
85 Invention to use Ancient gizmos blueprint; 93 for Ancient tools; 106 for XP Capacitor
Tradeable GE blueprints exist for main-game buyers — no-trade League must self-craft at Stormguard

upgrade.name: Inspire Genius (Howl's Thinking Cap)

requirements: Kandarin: Armadylean III collection artefacts from Stormguard Citadel
Asgarnia support: turn in to Lowse at Armadyl's Tower for Howl's Thinking Cap
118 Archaeology listed on relic; boosts can restore/excavate as early as ~110 with pulse cores
5,000 chronotes and 250 monolith energy to harness
